artifacts.summary: Confirms the has("file_scope") vs type-test asymmetry as the crash's root cause, verifies a one-line (.file_scope|type)=="array" predicate swap fixes it while preserving D3 order-preserving dedup / no-manufacture / idempotence, and recommends extending an existing --fix regression fixture in test-validate-state.sh (two concrete placement options) rather than adding a new test file.
